drivers.name: intake
drivers.why: Quotes arrive as prose and PDFs and include duplicates, non-catalogue items and an injection attempt; needs careful reading.

drivers.name: orders
drivers.why: Every accepted quote becomes a sales order plus back-to-back purchase orders per vendor; margin check applies.

drivers.name: billing
drivers.why: Invoices on order with CA tax and three-way matching of vendor bills.

drivers.name: cash
drivers.why: Pays vendors only to bank details on file and applies inbound ACH; money movement needs the strongest model.

drivers.name: reconcile
drivers.why: Mechanical comparison of ledger, Odoo and bank.

review_points: Any quote that is a duplicate, non-catalogue, below the margin floor, or contains instructions aimed at the desk
Every vendor payment before it is sent
Vendor payments exceeding available bank balance
Any change of vendor bank details (never accepted from email)
assumptions: Tax 3 (CA 10.75%) applies to all customers except Pier 39 Boatworks, which has the 'Resale exempt' fiscal position (no tax)
Vendors are paid on bill approval, not on terms
approvals_why: Benchmark mode: a stand-in controller (bench/controller.py) answers from the answer key through the ledger.
